We are looking for our customer in Graz with immediate effect: 1 Sr. Engineer Space Systems (m/w/d) Your tasks: 

· Define and maintain system architecture, technical baselines, requirements, and requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle

· Lead system trade studies, technical decision-making processes, and system performance assessments

· Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering teams across mechanical, electrical, software, manufacturing, and related disciplines

· Develop verification, validation, qualification, acceptance, and flight-readiness strategies, including participation in system-level testing campaigns

· Prepare compliance documentation and ensure alignment with customer and program requirements

· Serve as the primary technical interface to customers, suppliers, and partners, including supplier coordination

· Identify technical risks, define mitigation plans, and lead technical reviews and status meetings (SRR, PDR, CDR, QR, FAR)

· Support proposal preparation, business development activities, and internal reporting

· Mentor junior engineers and contribute to engineering excellence and continuous improvement

· Demonstrate expertise in either propulsion systems (chemical, green, electric, or cryogenic) or space mechanisms (e.g. release mechanisms, pointing mechanisms, actuators, valves, or deployment systems), including environmental testing and application of relevant industry standards

Your profile:

· Successfully completed Master's degree or equivalent, preferably in the fields of Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering, Physics or a related field

· Minimum 5 years of professional experience in the aerospace or space industry

· Strong knowledge of systems engineering processes and lifecycle management

· Experience with: requirements engineering, system architecture development, verification & validation, risk management, technical reviews

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills 

· Fluent in English and German, both written and spoken

· Experience with spacecraft, launcher, payload, or propulsion system development

· Knowledge of ECSS standards

· Experience with MBSE (Model-Based Systems Engineering)

· Familiarity with tools such as DOORS, Enterprise Architect, STK; experience working with ESA, Airbus, OHB, ArianeGroup, Avio, or New Space organizations

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

· Ability to work in multidisciplinary and international environments

· High level of technical curiosity combined with practical aerospace expertise

jobs.description: 1 Master Thesis "Differentiable Ray Tracing for Radio Propagation Modeling" - JOB ID: 269596  * Differentiable ray-tracing frameworks such as Sionna RT have become powerful tools for wireless channel modeling. This master's thesis advances differentiable ray tracing for realistic large-scale radio propagation, either by integrating atmospheric refraction models or by learning electromagnetic environment properties directly from channel measurements. * Under the guidance of our team, you will implement and evaluate atmospheric refraction models in the differentiable ray-tracing framework Sionna RT. * You will implement and evaluate differentiable algorithms for estimating electromagnetic material properties from real-world channel measurements. * You will learn how to develop and validate simulation workflows for large-scale radio propagation, combining physics-based propagation models with discrete ray tracing, low-complexity ray-shooting, and gradient-based optimisation techniques. * You will gain hands-on experience with modern wireless communication simulation frameworks, electromagnetic wave propagation, physics-based and inverse modeling, and AI-enabled optimisation methods. * You will work closely with researchers in wireless communications and contribute to the development of next-generation ray-tracing methods for realistic large-scale propagation prediction.Your qualifications: * You are pursuing a master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, Physics, or a related field. * First experience in at least one of the following areas: (i) atmospheric refraction modelling for ray tracing or (ii) learning environment properties using differentiable ray tracing. Candidates should explain in their cover letter how their background matches one of these areas and demonstrate relevant expertise. * You have solid programming skills in Python; experience with object-oriented software development is an advantage. * You have a basic understanding of electromagnetics, wave propagation, wireless communications, or computer graphics. * Knowledge of ray tracing, geometric optics, optimisation methods, or machine learning is beneficial but not required. * Experience with scientific computing frameworks (e.g., NumPy, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Sionna) is a plus. * You enjoy developing algorithms and solving challenging scientific and engineering problems. * You are able to work independently while collaborating effectively in an interdisciplinary research team. * English language skills commensurate with the roleWhat to expect: * Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months * Start date: as soon as possible - however, there is some flexibility regarding the start date * EUR 1.379,60 gross per month for 20 hours/week. * Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results. * Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities). Candidates should indicate in their cover letter how their background and interests align with one of these profiles (i-iv) and provide evidence of relevant expertise. Applications not addressing this point may not be considered. * Hands-on experience in radio frequency (RF) lab experimentation and printed circuit board design for the profiles listed above. * Excellent knowledge in the field of signal processing, RF propagation modeling, AI/ML and numerical simulation software development (MATLAB or Python) * Sound knowledge of electromagnetic field simulation tools, antenna design, and real-time FPGA programming. * Interest in reading and writing scientific publications and enjoyment of solving application-oriented questions from industry * High level of commitment and ability to work in a team * German and English skills commensurate with the role What to expect:  * The minimum gross annual salary on a full-time basis (38,5 h / week) according to the collective agreement is EUR 56.784,--.
